notes.title: Training Grounds, Companion Demons, Damage Statistics
notes.notes:
1. Training Grounds
	A new open area has appeared east of Crescent City: the Training Grounds.
	Talk to Farmer Liu Da to receive the quest to enter the Training Grounds.
	The quest is very simple!

2. Companion Demons
	Upon entering the Training Grounds, a panel to summon companions will appear. You can use it to summon companions.
	There are 12 groups of monsters in total, with each group having 4 variants, including elite and champion versions.
	The monster levels and difficulty will change according to the character's level and world difficulty.

3. Damage Statistics
	Upon entering the Training Grounds, a damage statistics panel will appear. You can use it to test your performance.
	The default statistic time is currently set to 5 seconds, but it can be adjusted.
	Additionally, please note that you can still die in the Training Grounds!
	In the Training Grounds, taking hits or dying will not reduce the durability of your equipment.

notes.title: Retrospection Gate, Retrospection Stone, Survival Skill Optimization
notes.notes:
1. Retrospection Gate and Retrospection Stone
	After using the Town Portal, a "Retrospection Gate" will appear in the main city.
	If you have a "Retrospection Stone" in your inventory, you can interact with the "Retrospection Gate" to teleport back to the previous location where you used the Town Portal.

2. Survival Skill Optimization
	The progress bars for skills like Town Portal, Herb Gathering, and Chest Opening are now more precise.
	Taking damage will interrupt actions such as Town Portal, Chest Opening, and Herb Gathering.
	The Town Portal skill cannot be used during boss battles.

notes.title: Steam Official Version 1.20b2 Released
notes.notes: * Emergency fixed a bug where the location was wrong after coming out of the Tianshan Cave

notes.title: Steam Official Version 1.20b Released
notes.notes:
* Emergency fix for a bug where random attributes could appear when crafting special blue and special gold items with the sound of jade.
* Fixed a bug in the character selection screen where equipment entries could not properly display perfect status, as well as gems and magic contracts.

notes.title: Emergency fix to a bug that could damage Jade Echo equipment
notes.notes: The contents are as indicated by the title

notes.title: Blue-Gold Storm, Jade Echo, Heavy Injury Dissolved, Light Injury Dissolved
notes.notes:
1. Jade Echo
All gold and blue gear can now be used to craft Jade Echo.
The restriction that gold and blue gear with special names could not be used to craft Jade Echo has been removed.

2. Injury Dissolved Limits
Heavy Injury Dissolved now has an upper limit of 90%.
Light Injury Dissolved now has an upper limit of 50 points.

3. Other Adjustments
The set effect of the Camel Bell set no longer reduces health by 400 points; it now reduces health by 300 points.

notes.title: Three Boss Resets: Sandworm Takes Flight, Stone Giant Revives, White Bear Rages
notes.notes:
Update Content:

I. Stone Giant Revives
	The model and skills of the Mountain Water Essence Stone Giant have been completely redone.
	The Stone Giant, now with stomping, double fists, and summoning skills, is more challenging.
	The scene and lighting of the Tianshan Cavern have been completely reset, making it darker.

II. White Bear Rages
	The model and skills of the honey-stealing White Bear Spirit have been reset.
	A larger character size, longer attack range, and more significant attack effects.
	The scene and lighting of the Kunlun Ice Cave have been completely reset, trying out a new shader.

III. Sandworm Takes Flight
	The vicious Scorpion King has been replaced by a large worm, with its model and skills entirely changed.
	This giant worm's skills include taking flight, toxin spraying, and sand head pounding.
	Thicker health and more challenging combat.

IV. Other Fixes
	Fixed the bug where Gu Qingming and Yuwen's transferred attributes were not displayed in time.
	Fixed the issue where the blocking wall didn't disappear after losing to Senior Sister and fighting again.
	Fixed the icon display of buffs for some bosses.
	Increased the attack power of Yuwen Jingzhe's Flying Flower Sword by 50%.
	Extended the berserk duration of Mangzi's Jiang Jiao Demon Girl by 1.5 seconds.
	Slightly extended the duration of Mangzi's Flower Butterfly skill, but also increased the attack interval accordingly.
	Slightly reduced the post-cast delay of Mangzi's Forest Bat skill.
	Adjusted the effects of the special blue equipment "Silken Golden".

Mangzi strengthening, Goddess protection, and attribute sharing for followers
notes.notes:
Minor Fixes:

1. The formula for attribute sharing among followers has been modified: Half of the received "follower transfer attributes" will be completely absorbed, and the other half will be divided among the number of followers.
2. The super skill "Goddess Protection" now allows Blade Masters to correctly exit the battlefield and recover health.
3. The pre-attack animation of the "Half Moon Slash" has been optimized, reducing the attack speed from 0.5 seconds to 0.3 seconds.
4. The pre-attack animation of "Silkworm Cluster," "Fish Heron," "Cypress," and "Song of the Oriole" has been optimized, reducing the effective time from 1.4 seconds to 0.5 seconds.
5. The skill tips panel now correctly displays the cooldown time of skills.
6. The basic evasion of monsters has been changed from 2% to 0% in difficulty 0.
7. The announcement content has been slightly modified, and the announcement will only pop up when the game is opened, not after SL.
8. The English version has undergone some updates in terms of wording.

notes.title: Gem drops, Magic Seal drops
notes.notes:
Small patch：
Fixed a bug where gem drops and some Magic Seal drops were abnormal during yesterday's update.

notes.title: Monk's hut, Travel icon, Brave Crystal Yuan
notes.notes:
Minor Fixes:
1. Gems governing gem drops now yield more gems.
2. Drops from certain world secrets can now be affected by Crimson item drops.
3. Fixed the icon of the Traveler's Guide, which inexplicably turned black previously.
4. Inn teleportation no longer teleports to the Monk's Hut but to the Great Buddha Shrine; killing Nightlight Bats 3 times enables teleportation.
5. Upon forced refresh and entering the map, a prompt message will now be displayed.
6. Gu Qingming: Fixed the description of Snowflake Six Directions talent, Ghost Shadow Pursuit talent and skill descriptions, and Swallow Swirl skill description.
7. Mangzi's Crescent Moon Slash damage type changed to melee damage, Starlight Scatter changed to ranged damage.
8. Corrected text errors in Mangzi's prologue in the storyline.
9. Added a hint about secret drops in the monster handbook, as too many people were asking.
10. Adjusted lighting between bosses in East Desert, outside of Tianhuo Mountain, and Fire God Temple.
11. Made some adjustments to the size and layout of surface textures on the map.
12. Added to the list of developers: "720 Niang Who Charges In," for assisting in polishing quest texts. Thanks for the help!

Steam official version v1.1.11 new version - 20240224
Lantern Festival is here, and Leopard Taro arrives!
notes.notes:
Updates:

Just as the Year Beast leaves, the Guild Hall welcomes Leopard Taro!

Innkeeper Mingyue at the Howling Moon Inn has a new task for you.
The Guild Hall is frozen in the chill of late spring.
Leopard Taro wears powerful silver armor, the more hits he takes, the higher his defense!
Immune to debuffs such as life drain, blindness, and intimidation!
Like other legendary bosses, starting at difficulty level two, the instance resets upon completion.
Completing the task rewards a Black Leopard mount.
Welcome all heroes to join the challenge!
Numerical Adjustments:

After 5 seconds of blindness, there will be a 10-second period of resistance.
Cooldown for life drain increased from 0.5 seconds to 1 second.
Maximum level of bleeding reduced from 20 to 10.
Description of charging effect has been appropriately modified.
Buff icon added for Sword Qi Double Dragon.
Normal modification made to the talent description of Gu Qingming's Seven Toads Spirit Realm.
Other Fixes:

Fixed an issue where a character would continue to attack a monster for a period of time, causing possible lag on laptops.
Fixed a bug where the Desert Mirage wouldn't refresh the second time entering, resulting in no teleportation portal.
Adjusted the triggering area of the Forbidden Area in the Back Mountain, removing monsters that affect the storyline.
Fixed an issue where the duration of buffs did not increase with level.
Fixed a bug where the sound of flowing water in the Tianshan Path would persist.
Art-related:

Minor adjustments made to the lighting in some scenes.
The lighting in the valley has been changed to night.
Fixed an issue where certain scene effects would not display properly during cutscenes.

notes.title: Steam Official Version v1.1.10 - 20240221
notes.notes:
I. Professions and Attributes:

Fixed a bug where Gu Qingming's Xuan Yi Lian Ci couldn't hit nearby targets.
Addressed an issue where poisoning with Gu Qingming's Xuan Guang Fen sometimes failed.
Gu Qingming's talent for Sword Wind Step now reduces cooldown time, increases skill level, and adds more uses.
Fixed a passive skill bug with Gu Qingming's automatic Lucky Point addition, resolving its ineffectiveness after level 2.
Slightly increased the damage of Gu Qingming's Xuan Guang Zhan.
Reduced the HP deduction of Xue Ming from 12.5% to 10%.
II. Power, Attributes, and Inventory:

Rectified icons and descriptions of all late-game power buffs.
Separated cooldown acceleration during battles from pre-battle cooldown reduction, fixing bugs related to cooldown reduction caused by skills like Gu Qingming's Concealed Shadow, Ghostly Echoes, Yuwen's Rapid Command, as well as Thunder Dragon's Roar, Hesperidium, and Fairy Bite Pact.
Fixed anomalies in UITips, skill buttons, and actual character cooldown reduction.
III. Scenes and Quests:

Adjusted monster positions and loot bag placements in Tian Shan Path.
Refine layouts in the Sword Casting Cave level.
Adjusted the positions of fire basin switches in Sandworm Cave, consolidating three switches into one.
After killing Chi Yang in the Crimson Flame Cave, a portal to Mount Tianhuo will now open.
Modified the rewards for the Blacksmith Tools quest, adding artifact rewards.
Characters will now prioritize displaying death animations during cutscenes.
IV. Art Related:

Adjusted lighting, fog effects, and post-effects contrast parameters in Tian Shan, Kunlun Mountain, East City Desert, Ghost Wilderness, Sandworm Cave, etc.
Refined some scenes (such as Tian Shan and Kunlun Mountain series maps), replacing some low-poly models.
When revealing the fog on the minimap, the range now matches the scene's field of view.
Added a minimap, including adjustments to the display size of its markers.
V. Optimization:

Modified the logic for selling items in the inventory, fixing issues where common and rare equipment couldn't be sold correctly.
Optimized some action codes to prevent potential errors when NPCs and chests perform actions.
Made some optimizations to the camera to improve efficiency.
Slightly improved UI efficiency.
Changed the image properties of the in-game mouse cursor icons.

notes.title: Version 1.1.09 of Steam - February 14, 2024 (Summoner Enhanced)
notes.notes:
[h1]I. Career Adjustments[/h1]
Partial reduction in the consumption of Moon Series minions by Mangzi.
The life growth value of all of Mangzi's minions (possibly from talents or skill levels) has been increased from 20 points to 40 points each time.
Fine-tuning of the resistance effect of Mangzi's Moon Guardian talent, while also increasing the resistance limit.
Reduction in cooldown time for Mangzi's Song of the Woodcock.
Correction of the effect of Gu Qingming's Ghost Shadow talent.
Restoration of the effects of Yuwen Jingzhe's Great Luo Zhou Tian Sword Array and Cold Plum Sword Array skill books.

[h1]II. Items and Attributes[/h1]
Addition of Magic Contract: Song of Water Wilderness, which adds 2% bleeding to minions, in the advanced drops of the Nian Beast.
Addition of Magic Contract: Song of Nine Infants, which adds 2% life reduction to minions, in the advanced drops of the Chiyang.
Light Wound Resolution and Heavy Wound Resolution also apply to life-consuming skills, such as Mangzi's summoning of Moon Blade Hands.
Modification of bleeding effect: no longer triggers when hitting, with bleeding stacks changed to 20 layers.
Modification of the "Fisherman" attribute to Light Wound Resolution.
Expansion of the maximum damage value attribute derived from "Nine Stars".
Fix for the bug where super attributes of minions are not effective.

[h1]III. Monster Related[/h1]
Increased the time interval for Chiyang's soaring by 15 seconds for easier farming.
Increased drop rate of advanced gems for Thunder Dragon.

[h1]IV. Usability Modifications[/h1]
Holding the Alt key and clicking on items in the backpack, character, and other panels will discard the item.
The prompt for special blue equipment is always on, instead of Ctrl prompt.
In addition to the claim option, DLC now includes a purchase option to facilitate repurchase for players who have sold corresponding items.

notes.notes:
Update content:

The Year Beast has arrived in Crescent Moon City, welcome to challenge!
Crescent Moon City's Pipa Girl has tasks to offer!
Passersby Huo Shaodou sells tangyuan, firecrackers, and mahaleizi, which can be used to challenge the Year Beast!
The initial difficulty of the Year Beast is level two, resetting upon exiting the instance, with full-level wound resolution (99%), making its life-draining abilities no longer mysterious!
Welcome all martial artists to participate in the challenge!

notes.title: steam v1.1.05 version - 20240207
notes.notes:
Updates:
I. Drop rate modification
Fixed the bug of extremely low drop rates for Hou Xiaoman and Leilong's jades, now strictly matching the illustrated handbook.

II. Battle-related
Expanded the attack range of Gu Qingming Xuan's continuous stabbing skill, increased damage duration, and adjusted the position length of the damage hitbox.
Modified the skill descriptions of Mangzi's Crescent Blade Hand and Crescent Law Enforcement.
Changed the calculation order of minor wound mitigation to after major wound mitigation;
Increased the strength of the minor wound mitigation affix by 1x;

III. Pet modifications [Important]
Added a control for pets, clicking on the pet icon in the upper left corner will quickly bring the pet to the player's side, default hotkeys Alt+1~6.
When the character takes an elevator, all pets will automatically gather.

IV. Sound effect modifications
Adjusted the volume of some sounds to prevent certain monster sounds from being particularly harsh.
Replaced some sound effects, such as the level-up sound.
Monster shouting text will display normally.

V. Fixed save file issues
Fixed potential anomalies in save file loading for some players, shared save files (including settings information) will be directly deleted if issues occur, character save files with issues will be skipped but not deleted.

notes.title: steam v1.1.04 version - 20240206
Tales of Spark is online! 3 new classes are available for you to experience!
notes.notes:
Include Full English, Русский, 日本語, 한국어, Italiano！
And Deutsch, Español, Français, Português, Tiếng Việt is on the way! In no time. 

Hello, friends! We're here! Our ancient-style dark fantasy game "The Cataclysm of Divine Stone" is now released!

Thank you so much for your help last year. We received a lot of attention and support, and we're here to report what's new in this EA version. We hope for your continued support!

New Characters, New Chapters
The first is the Nan Zhao Priestess "Mangzi," a character who relies on summons and spell attacks. She can summon spirits of the natural world and also wield the mysterious lunar power of the Nan Zhao Priestess to summon attacks from the Moon Clan.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054617/a2db44d6dc71138292a40fdc42e7b21d37c05ae2.png[/img]

The second is the assassin-type character "Gu Qingming," who has extremely high burst damage and powerful mobility. Skilled in hiding and using tools like darts and poisons for attack, enhanced movement speed and displacement techniques make him more agile compared to other characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054617/18518283c8c594723c0e6dc18d041903245cc760.png[/img]

New World, New Adventures
In addition to repairing existing areas, we're introducing more brand-new regions for players to explore! Four new maps, over a dozen bosses, and countless types of enemies await.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054617/a178c0500fb27458fab5bbd5209225bb98dcc8af.png[/img]

Mysterious Magic Contracts, Power Awakening
We've added a total of over 80 pieces of high-level equipment this time. Compared to ordinary equipment, most high-level equipment comes with magic contracts attached. These contracts can be extracted and transplanted onto other equipment. We've also adjusted the drop rates of scattered magic contracts to make it easier for players to freely build their desired playstyles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054617/ebcb52071c51903aa9bad6de8e2074936ba56caa.png[/img]

Jade Echo
By embedding specific gemstones, various special effects can be activated on equipment. This time, we've significantly strengthened the existing Jade Echoes and introduced many new ones, making battles in the game even more exhilarating.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054617/836a96f4052bc7d19180e96db5b156cc81e7d89e.png[/img]

There are many other miscellaneous optimizations and adjustments that we won't list one by one. Thank you very much for helping us test and optimize the game. Many of our friends in the group are players from our community, and under their supervision, we believe we've polished the game quite well. We hope for your support and once again invite everyone to play and chat in the group (https://discord.gg/PShaTS8ZKh).

notes.title: [Version Update] "Oriental Game Week" Theme Task: Above the Clouds
notes.notes:
1、 Above the Clouds and Rainbows - Dragon's Residence

Add the first legendary boss of the game: Yunting Thunderdragon.

Possessing exceptional health, full screen attack ability, map forcing difficulty of 3, boss gap is about to be reset.

Task Entry: Huo Shaodu, at the entrance of the Crescent Town Inn.

Related task rewards:???



[i] Although the turtle has a long lifespan, there is still a chance.

The snake rides in the mist, and eventually turns into dust.

An old hero is full of ambition.

In the old age of the martyr, he is full of determination [/i]




2、 Scenario optimization

1. Add details to Crescent City, and add stairs at the entrance and exit of the inn.

2. Optimize indoor map lighting such as Sandworm Cave, Wanxiang Cave, and cellar, and try using overhead spotlights for lighting.



3、 Repair related data

1. Slightly optimized hand feel, more coherent when continuously releasing the same skill.

2. The wind generated by the foot is equally effective for all friendly units.

3. The disciples of the same sect have slightly weakened, with a decrease of 15%.

4. Xuantian Divine Sword adds additional Xuanfa damage.

5. Description of Thunderbolt Sword modification.

6. The spell protection ability of armor has been slightly improved.

7. Refine descriptions of armor, monster damage, etc.

8. Fix the drop of White Bear Spirit that steals honey.



4、 Fix some bugs

1. Fix the bug where the storyline sound of the mechanical hard drive will play repeatedly.

2. Fix the missing bug in the dialogue in section 1.7.

3. In the corner selection interface, non optional characters have undergone shadow processing.

4. When the store interface opens, open the backpack interface.

When the durability of the equipment on the body is not satisfactory, there will be a highlight prompt for repair in the store.

6. Press the Right Control key to display the white blue gold affix function.
